name: Transfer
summary: Two lists side by side with a button between them: what is available on one side, what has been chosen on the other. The whole thing is a form, so the move is a submission.
summaryZh: 并排的两个列表,中间一个按钮:一边是可选的,另一边是已选的。整块东西是一个表单,所以「移动」是一次提交。

variants.name: Horizontal
variants.note: The two panels sit side by side and the buttons sit between them. The base class on its own is this layout, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: Vertical
variants.note: The panels stack one above the other and the buttons sit between them in a row, for a narrow column.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The file names take the caption size and the move buttons follow the theme's small control height.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The names take the title size and the move buttons follow the theme's large control height.

states.name: Checked
states.note: A ticked option takes the brand colour's own soft tint, and its text takes the foreground that was derived for that tint.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: A disabled option takes the derived disabled colour, and a disabled move button paints a flat surface and takes that same colour.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: Each control takes its own ring, because one ring around the whole box would say the wrong thing about what is focused.

states.name: Filterable
states.note: Each panel carries the field the host filters the list with.

states.name: Virtual scroll
states.note: The rows far from the reader are not laid out: the browser gives them a placeholder size instead, so the scrollbar is right without every row being built.

parts.name: Panel
parts.note: One of the two lists, with its header and its options. It is a <section>, so it is announced as a region when it is given a label.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: The row at the top of a panel. It holds the title and the count.

parts.name: Count
parts.note: How many items the panel holds, of how many there are. It is text, so it takes the muted role.

parts.name: List
parts.note: The scrollable run of the panel's options.

parts.name: Option
parts.note: The label that wraps the real input, the checkbox component's box and the text, so it is the element that can be asked whether its input is ticked.

parts.name: Controls
parts.note: The pair of buttons between the panels.

parts.name: Move
parts.note: The button that moves the ticked options into the target panel. Its arrow is drawn from borders, so it carries no text of its own.

parts.name: Move back
parts.note: The button that moves the ticked options back into the source panel.

parts.name: Footer
parts.note: The row under a panel's list, where a host puts whatever that panel needs. An empty footer is no footer.

parts.name: Filter
parts.note: The field the host filters a panel's list with. It is a real search field, so the browser's own clear mark and its own keyboard are there.

parts.name: Left empty
parts.note: What the panel on the left says when it holds no option. It is shown only when that panel's list is empty.

parts.name: Right empty
parts.note: What the panel on the right says when it holds no option. It is shown only when that panel's list is empty.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the ticked options are submitted under. It is the native name attribute, and the source and the target list use different names so the host can tell them apart.
props.descriptionZh: 勾上的选项提交时用的名字。它是原生 name 属性,两个列表用不同的名字,宿主才分得清谁是谁。

props.name: value
props.description: The value one option submits while it is ticked.
props.descriptionZh: 某个选项勾上时提交的值。

props.name: model-value
props.description: The bound value. It answers to `v-model` as well as to `value`, and the binding wins when it is there.
props.descriptionZh: 绑定的值。它和 `value` 一样能接 `v-model`,而且绑定在的时候以绑定为准。

props.name: checked
props.description: Ticks one option. It is the native checked attribute, not a class.
props.descriptionZh: 勾上某一个选项。它是原生 checked 属性,不是某个类。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes one option, or one of the move buttons, inert. It uses the real disabled attribute, so it leaves the tab order.
props.descriptionZh: 让某个选项或某个移动按钮不可用。它用的是原生 disabled 属性,因此会退出 Tab 顺序。

props.name: direction
props.description: Which way the two panels are laid out. The horizontal run is the base class on its own; the vertical run adds um-transfer--vertical.
props.descriptionZh: 两个面板怎么排。横向是只写基础类;纵向再加上 um-transfer--vertical。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the names and of the move buttons.
props.descriptionZh: 文字和移动按钮的尺寸。

props.name: filterable
props.description: Whether each panel carries the field the host filters the list with. The field is a real search input, so the filtering is the host's script and the library only draws it. It adds um-transfer--filterable.
props.descriptionZh: 每个面板上是否带上那个用来筛选列表的输入框。这个输入框是真的搜索框,所以筛选是宿主脚本的事,库只负责画它。它加上 um-transfer--filterable。

props.name: virtual-scroll
props.description: Whether the rows far from the reader are left out of the layout. The browser is told how tall such a row is, so the scrollbar is right without every row being built. It adds um-transfer--virtual-scroll.
props.descriptionZh: 离读者很远的那些行是否不参与排版。浏览器会被告知这种行有多高,所以不用把每一行都建出来,滚动条也是对的。它加上 um-transfer--virtual-scroll。

slots.name: source
slots.description: The options of the panel on the left.
slots.descriptionZh: 左边那个面板里的选项。

slots.name: target
slots.description: The options of the panel on the right.
slots.descriptionZh: 右边那个面板里的选项。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The options of the panel on the left. It is the name Element Plus gives the same content the source slot fills.
slots.descriptionZh: 左边那个面板里的选项。它是 Element Plus 给 source 插槽所填的同一份内容起的名字。

slots.name: left-footer
slots.description: The row under the list of the panel on the left.
slots.descriptionZh: 左边那个面板列表下面的那一行。

slots.name: right-footer
slots.description: The row under the list of the panel on the right.
slots.descriptionZh: 右边那个面板列表下面的那一行。

slots.name: left-empty
slots.description: What the panel on the left says when it holds no option at all.
slots.descriptionZh: 左边那个面板一个选项都没有的时候说什么。

slots.name: right-empty
slots.description: What the panel on the right says when it holds no option at all.
slots.descriptionZh: 右边那个面板一个选项都没有的时候说什么。

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when an option is ticked or unticked. It is the browser's own event on the input — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 某个选项被勾选或取消勾选时触发。这是 input 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

events.name: submit
events.description: Fires when the form is submitted, which is how a move happens: the buttons carry the direction in their value and the ticked items in the form's own fields.
events.descriptionZh: 表单提交时触发,移动就是这么发生的:按钮的 value 里带着方向,勾上的项目在表单自己的字段里。

a11y.notes: Every option is a real <input type="checkbox"> inside a <label>, so ticking it is the browser's :checked and the value submits with the form. The two move buttons are real buttons, so they are in the tab order and can be pressed — but their arrows are drawn from borders, so each one needs an aria-label saying which way it moves. The move itself is a submission: the library has no JavaScript, so the host that receives the form does the moving and writes the two lists back.
a11y.notesZh: 每个选项都是 <label> 里一个真正的 <input type="checkbox">,勾选走的就是浏览器的 :checked,值会随表单提交。两个移动按钮是真的 button,所以在 Tab 顺序里、可以按 —— 但箭头是边框画出来的,所以每个都得有一个 aria-label 说明它是往哪边移。移动本身是一次提交:库没有 JavaScript,所以由收到表单的宿主来完成移动,再把两个列表写回来。

examples.title: Horizontal
examples.description: The two panels side by side. The move buttons are real submit buttons, so the form posts what is ticked and in which direction; the host that receives it does the moving.
examples.descriptionZh: 两个面板并排放。移动按钮是真的提交按钮,所以表单会把勾上的项目和方向一起提交出去;收到它的宿主来完成移动。
examples.markup:
Available 3 / 5
Chosen 2 / 5

examples.title: Vertical
examples.description: The same two panels stacked one above the other, with the buttons between them in a row. Only the modifier class changes.
examples.descriptionZh: 同样两个面板上下叠着,按钮横排在中间。变的只有那个修饰类。
examples.markup:
Available 1 / 2
Chosen 1 / 2

notes: The move is a submission, not an animation. The buttons are real submit buttons that carry their direction in their value, and the ticked options are the form's own fields, so a host that receives the post can move them and write the two lists back. The library draws the two panels, the rows and the arrows; the arrows are shapes made of borders, so they take the button's colour and need no glyph of its own.
notesZh: 移动是一次提交,不是一个动画。那两个按钮是真的提交按钮,方向就写在它们的 value 里;勾上的选项是表单自己的字段,所以收到这次提交的宿主可以把它们移过去,再把两个列表写回来。库负责画两个面板、那些行和那两个箭头;箭头是用边框做的形状,所以它们跟着按钮的颜色走,自己不带任何字形。
